title: Core Validation 009C — Sparse / Local Effect Geometry
decision_question: After global compact linear effect geometry fails, are carrier-preserved causal effects nevertheless reusable through sparse overcomplete composition or a small union of local low-dimensional charts, with train-only fitting and heldout assignment?

data.selection_and_partition: exact Core 006/007/009A/009B pinned selection; train/eval filtering unchanged

effect_definition.carrier: r = normalized mean of train-token projected activations z, fitted independently per seed using train only

sparse_dictionary.initialization: deterministic SHA-ordered train effects followed by deterministic Gaussian fill when K>N
sparse_dictionary.coding: OMP with exact least-squares refit on selected atoms
sparse_dictionary.update: MOD least-squares dictionary update followed by unit-norm atom normalization
sparse_dictionary.selection_metric: heldout median normalized residual, then smaller sparsity, then smaller atom count
sparse_dictionary.description_bits: support IDs use s*ceil(log2(K)) bits; coefficients reported separately at 16 and 32 bits

local_subspaces.clustering: deterministic spherical k-means on train effects only
local_subspaces.chart_fit: origin-preserving PCA independently inside each train cluster
local_subspaces.eval_assignment: nearest train centroid by cosine; eval effects never alter centroids or bases

nulls.random_dictionary: deterministic Gaussian unit-norm atoms with the same K and OMP sparsity
nulls.random_chart_assignment: deterministic hash assignment with same chart counts and local dimensions
nulls.purpose: positive evidence must beat non-learned capacity-matched controls

discovery.selection_rule: A family is discovery-viable only if one fixed configuration independently passes every gate on both discovery seeds. Prefer sparse over local only by lower per-write active dimension after residual gates; no cross-family cherry-picking per seed.

growth_diagnostic.sparse_rule: append a normalized residual atom only when locked sparse dictionary cannot reconstruct the arriving train effect below tau at locked sparsity
growth_diagnostic.local_rule: spawn a new chart only when no locked chart reconstructs the arriving train effect below tau
growth_diagnostic.interpretation: growth is diagnostic in 009C and cannot rescue a discovery configuration

replication.formal_hardware: Kaggle GPU for frozen hidden/gradient extraction; 64D sparse/local geometry is CPU-safe after extraction

stop_rule.discovery_failure: Do not open confirmation. Return to the full G_i operator and freeze a bilinear/compositional representation hypothesis before further addressability work.
stop_rule.confirmation_failure: Do not open deployable routing. Sparse/local carrier-effect geometry is not a supported CLM substrate under this protocol.
stop_rule.confirmation_success: Proceed to deployable addressability for the locked sparse/local representation, then certificates and growth.

interpretation_boundary: A positive sparse result supports sparse composition of carrier effects, not natural semantic Cells.
A positive local result supports a union-of-subspaces effect model, not inference-visible routing.
A negative result rejects these representations of a_i only; it does not reject operator-level factorization of G_i or engineered adaptive modules.
No semantic/source label may be used for dictionary fitting, clustering, configuration selection or heldout assignment.
